body:
Recovery recipe, proven on TermAl's WinB on 2026-11-27 (Engram defect w-c39164e2c07b, route by Engram::Opus, approved by Engram::Fable).

Symptom: ordinary import refuses with task_sync_divergent_planning on an item the LOCAL host REVISED. Cause: a reconciliation HOLD (reconciliation/holds.rs, ancestor_binding) in the same graph component makes import re-read the locally revised item. This is NOT a live claim: ordinary import does not read live claims (Engram::Fable, ebe242f7 #9006). Never release claims to try to clear it. Export refuses with task_sync_incremental_basis_unavailable because data HEAD isn't the admitted basis. Engram's printed set-aside remedy LOOPS in that state.

ROUTE C, which only moves forward:
0. Capture read-only diagnostics: import --dry-run --json and the envelope.
1. The item's holder saves `show <item> --full`.
2. `git revert --no-edit <set-aside>`, if one was made.
3. The holder revises the item back to its text at the basis commit.
4. Run an ordinary import.
5. The holder re-applies the saved revise exactly.
6. Ordinary export, commit, confirm-import, a net check against the incoming tip (zero deletions, disclosure clean), HTTPS fast-forward push.

NOT approved: a branch reset, export --rebuild, or releasing claims.

COMPLETION VARIANT (2026-11-27 06:46Z, WinB, w-7e7c completed locally): Route C does NOT apply, because a seal can't be revised back. Take the route from Engram::Opus (owner of w-c391) only. If its set-aside refuses, stop and wait for w-c391 (candidate aee7d7cf) to land and be installed on the affected host, then import and export normally. The completion stays sealed locally; nobody redoes it elsewhere.

Prevention: until w-c391 lands, run criteria revises on Central, or sync before revising.
